origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: D aɣersiw n telqey  yesɛan takemmict, d arurad deg waman, yerna yezmer ad d-yessawel i yimdukkal-is. D arurad, yeqqur deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: Yettneffis aman s wudem agaman am uzwu, yettwali-d akken ilaq deg-s war tagut.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Timina s tɣawla tameqqrant ticki llant deg waman.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: Iteddu cwiṭ s tɣawla deg waman.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Aman yeldin
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: Yettɛummu akken ilaq ɣef lqaɛa n yilel, mačči kan rrif-is.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Tafesna n uḥric
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: Yettaṭṭaf lqay mi ara yeɣreq s wudem ummid deg umḍiq n uɣelluy. Aɛummu d akessar mazal iteddu akken iwata.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Aḥelluf
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Izmer kan ad yečč iselman. Inedbalen n uqeddac zemren ad sensen ayagi deg twila (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: Aḥelluf d uḥelluf azegzaw d ayen i d-yettaken lfakya am wid i d-yettwassewwen.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Yettḥerrik deg waman s uḥerrek iǧehden, iǧehden  s zzerb ugar n win yettidiren deg tjumma.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Allen mmugent i tillas timeqqranin. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Ad yerr 30% n lexṣara i d-yettwaṭṭfen ɣer yimakaren.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.d: +2 ulawen (+4 HP afellay). Tabyulujit n yilel lqayen tbennu-d akatar iǧehden ugar.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Timina s tɣawla tameqqrant ula ma llant deg waman.
Yettseḥlu s ttawil mi ara yili deg waman  azal n 1 HP yal 3 n tasinin.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: Yettḍurru 1.5 deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_land_speed_pena: Iteddu s 10% s ttawil deg wakal.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Yeqqur
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Aḍu yettruẓu ticki ur tesɛiḍ ara aman: ma teqqimeḍ aṭas deg tjumma, ad teffneḍ. Lgerra, tiɣmert n waman, aman yettneffsen neɣ abadu urmiden i d-yezzin ɣer tama-k, akk ad t-ṭṭfen.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Voidwalker
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Amdan i d-teḥuza Tfukt  yettɛedday deg yiḥedran, yettmerriḥ ɣef teɣzi wezzilen, yetteddu ur t-ttwalin ara tuget n yiberdan. Yettazzal mebla ɛeyyu, maca aman d lmeḥna.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Iɣewwaren ɣer wanda tettwaliḍ (ala 24 n yiḥedran). Yeswa 2 n yiɣewwaren. 80 n ticcert n usebded.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Yezmer ad iwali deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
Ur ttarran ara ddhen-nsen ɣur-k ala ma tεeddaḍ fell-asen.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: Yettḍurru 1 n tikelt deg tasint mi ara yili deg waman neɣ deg ugeffur  ilem yettaggad aman.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Stoneguard
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: Ilul-d seg uẓru amuddir  d aɛessas ur nḥerrek ara i d-yettḍeyyiɛen isennanen ɣef wid i d-yettnadin fell-as, yettɣaz aẓru s yifassen-is kan, yerra tifacin n uẓru yettfeǧǧiǧen deg tillas. Lqaɛa tarussint, maca ur tettḥerrik ara, ur tent-tettaǧǧa.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 n wulawen (+6 HP afellay). Tafekka n weblaḍ tettaṭṭaf ugar n uksum.
Ad yerr 20% n lexṣara i d-yettwaṭṭfen i yimakaren.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: Iteddu s 10% s ttawil ɣef umdan amagnu.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Iṛuza iḥedran s snat n tikkal s tɣawla.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Iɣerdayen ur d-ttnernin ara deg 48 n yiḥedran.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Verdan
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: Ameskan amuddir n umaḍal azegzaw  ur yeffiɣ ara leɛtab, deg talwit akked uḥeckul, maca yettwaɣ akk s lbaṭel n Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Akk lɣaci  ula d wid ur nemɛin ara  ur k-ttḥezziben ara alamma d win i k-id-yessukksen.
Iẓuran ttarran-d ifadden yal taggara. Ur d-yettḍurru ara ma yeɣli.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Yettarra-d tazmert s ttawil mi ara yili deg yibiyumen n teẓgi.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: Yettaṭṭaf 2 n wuguren i tasint mi ara yili deg Nether. Iceṭṭiḍen n uḥewwes n uẓeṭṭa iceṭṭhen akk i wuguren.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Agrud n tili  yettḍeyyiɛ tiɣawsiwin n tnezmart taberkant, yettazzal seg umkan ɣer wayeḍ, yettḥerrik isennanen. D arurad deg tillas, yeṛɣa s tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: Yettwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Tabzimt n tili
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Iteddu ɣer sdat s tɣawla meqqren deg tnila ideg tettedduḍ. Yeswa 2 n tnezmart. 60 n tikkal n usemmiḍ.
Yettḍurru 1 n tikelt deg tasint mi ara d-yeffeɣ i tafat n yiṭij srid.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Tizriḍin ttɛeddint mebla aɣilif deg talɣa-k yettwaḥulfun s tili.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Taferka n tili
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Sers tafergact ur nettban ara ara i d-yettawin azgen n 28 n yiḥedran deg tillas. Ar alamma d 4 n tfergacin i yermed ɣef tikelt; asers n yiwet tamaynut ad yekkes tin taqburt. Yeswa 2 n tnezmart. 60 n ticcert n usebded.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Yettawi-k-id s tezmert ɣer wanda tettnezziheḍ. Yeswa 2 n tnezmart. 4 n tasinin n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Dragan Wings
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Yettzuxxu s tlelli deg yigenni s wafriwen-is iǧehden.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Yettak-d nnefs n 4 n tebyilin timecṭaḥ n tmes deg tnila i tettmuquleḍ. Yeswa 3 n tfesniwin. 4 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Lbaraka n ugama
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Lɣella-nni i d-yezzin ɣer tama-k tettnerni s tɣawla, amzun d lbaraka i d-tefka lqaɛa.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Taneɣruft
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Yettarra akk iɣersiwen iqerben deg umkan-nsen s Slowness VI i 4 n tasinin. Yeswa 2 n teswiɛin n tudert. 200-tick cooldown.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Yettɛeddi s tfesniwin deg lḥiḍ s wudem i tettwaliḍ. 3 n tasinin n usewḥel.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Yessuffeɣ-d tazzla n tnezmart i d-yettfeǧǧiǧen deg yiwet n temnaḍt n tagut iweɛren. Yeswa 1 n tnezmart. 4 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Yettunefk-ak-d trident ameslub iǧehden (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) ticki tferneḍ aɣbalu-agi.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Iɣersiwen n yilel ur nemɛin ara  ikalmar, iselman, ilfinen  ttazzalen mi ara k-ẓren.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Ɛeddi s usurif deg yiwen n lḥiḍ s wudem i tettwaliḍ. Yeswa 3 n tnezmart. 80 n tiḥdayin n usemmiḍ.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Ad isers iḥder glowstone ɣef tjumma i tettwaliḍ. Asmi n usemmiḍ n 100 n ticraḍ.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Ma yerẓa uẓaṛ neɣ ifekran, ad d-yefk yiwen n ugraw-nniḍen n ticcertin.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.max_reach: Amḍan afellay n yiqeddacen yettwaɛerḍen yakan!
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: Tesriḍ %s n yiswiren n termit i useqdec n waya.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Ad yales awennez n tefrant n uɣbalu daɣen ad yeldi amsefran n uɣbalu. Ad yesqam 5 n yiswiren XP i useqdec yezrin (aseqdec amezwaru baṭel). Ad yettwaseqdec deg useqdec.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Ad yales awennez n tefrant n uɣbalu daɣen ad yeldi amsefran n uɣbalu. Ad yesqam 5 n yiswiren XP i useqdec yezrin (aseqdec amezwaru baṭel). Ad yettwaseqdec deg useqdec.
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: Tesriḍ %s n yiswiren n termit i useqdec n waya.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Ales awennez n tefrayt-ik·im kan n tneɣrit syen ales aldin n umsefran n tneɣrit, s uḥraz n uɣbalu-ik·im agejdan. Yeswa 2 n yiswiren XP i useqdec. Ad yettwakkes deg useqdec.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Ales awennez n tefrayt-ik·im kan n tneɣrit syen ales aldin n umsefran n tneɣrit, s uḥraz n uɣbalu-ik·im agejdan. Yeswa 2 n yiswiren XP i useqdec. Ad yettwakkes deg useqdec.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Inchling
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: Amdan s lqedd n ṛebɛa n tfesna, yettalin ɣef leḥyuḍ s sshala, yetteddu s tɣawla yessewhamen  maca tafekka taḥerfit tettas-d d akal.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: Ameẓyan
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.descripti: D amkuẓ kan n teɣzi tamagnut.
Yezmer ad yeṭṭef neɣ ad yeɣzif ɣef yal taffa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 n wulawen (-10 HP afellay). Tafekka s lqedd n kraḍ n yisekkilen tettawi-d kraḍ n leqriḥ.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: Iteddu s 15% s zzerb ɣef tannumi.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Yettlaẓ s uzgen n tɣawla ɣef umyurar amagnu.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Sporeling
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: Taḥawact n ufezzu i yettidiren deg tillas d wurtiyen n yiẓidanen  yeččur d tiẓidanin tisemmamin, maca yeqqur s tafat n yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Yettḍeyyiḍ s uḍebsi n uḍebsi ara d-yeffɣen deg usigna n uḍebsi n usemmiḍ. Yeswa 3 n yiɣallen n tudert. 12 n tasinin n usemmiḍ.
Yezmer ad iwali akken iwata deg tillas tummidt. Senfel s tqeffalt Night Vision (amezwer K).
